questions.q_en: If SCRIPT is coded as UETKRV, what is the code for EDITOR?
questions.solution_en:
From SCRIPT→UETKRV,

rule => add 2 to each letter's alphabetical position

EDITOR positions = E(5), D(4), I(9), T(20), O(15), R(18)

Add 2: 5+2=7, 4+2=6, 9+2=11, 20+2=22, 15+2=17, 18+2=20

Map back: 7→G, 6→F, 11→K, 22→V, 17→Q, 20→T → GFKVQT

= 241 ≠ RHS [Not satisfied]

Option (d): After replacement,

LHS = 405 ÷ 9 ÷ 5 - 3 X 2

= 45 ÷ 5 - 3 X 2

= 9 - 3 X 2

= 9 - 6

= 3 ≠ RHS [Not satisfied]

questions.q_en:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

All Note is Slip

Some Note is Chit

No Chit is Receipt

Conclusions:

I: Some Slip is Chit

II: Some Slip is not Receipt

III: No Note is Receipt
questions.solution_en:
Statements:

All Note is Slip

Some Note is Chit

No Chit is Receipt

Some Slip is Chit: All Note is Slip. Some Note is Chit. Thus, Some Slip is Chit. So, conclusion I is true.

Some Slip is not Receipt: Some Note is Chit. No Chit is Receipt. Thus, the Slip which is Chit is not Receipt. So, conclusion II is true.

No Note is Receipt: As there is no direct relation between Note and Receipt. So, conclusion III is false.

Hence, both conclusion I and conclusion II follow.
